wood: Wata budurwa ta tafi daji tare da ƙawayenta domin tara itacen wuta.
wood-2: Ta iya samun itace mai kyau, kuma sauran suna kishinta.
tree: A wannan rana, ta hau bishiya, ta zame, hannunta ya maƙale a cikin itacen.
left: Amma ƙawayenta suka bar ta a can.
left-2: Da suka koma ƙauye, mahaifiyarta ta tambayi inda 'yarta take.
song: Ita kaɗai a daji, budurwar tana sauraron takun ƙafa.
song-2: Duk lokacin da ta ji wani sauti, sai ta yi waƙa, tana fatan wani zai same ta.
hunter-2: Waƙar a dajin da babu kowa ta tsorata shi, sai ya gudu.
hunter-3: Amma ya tuna waƙar, daga baya ya kai ta ƙauye.
rescue-2: Suka tara mutane, adduna da kayan aiki, suka bi mafaraucin zuwa daji.
rescue-3: Da budurwar ta sake waƙa, sai muryoyi suka amsa.
rescue-4: Suka sare itacen suka 'yantar da ita.
wound: Amma hannunta ya ji rauni sosai.
wound-2: A gida, mahaifiyarta tana ganin wahalarta, tana tsoron ba za ta taɓa warkewa ba.
promise: Saboda damuwa, ta yi alkawarin cewa duk wanda ya warkar da 'yarta zai iya aurenta.
animals-3: Damisa ba ta iya warkar da ita ba.
animals-4: Zaki ma bai iya taimakawa ba.
hare-2: Waɗanda ke kusa suka yi shakka.
hare-5: A ƙarshe, mahaifiyarta ta bar shi ya gwada.
hare-6: Zomo ya yi amfani da magunguna daga yankin da suke zaune wajen kula da raunin.
healed: Ƙoƙarinsa ya yi nasara, kuma budurwar ta warke.
suitors: Ba da daɗewa ba, masu neman aure suka fara zuwa.
suitors-4: Kowa yana fatan ta zaɓe shi.
choice-3: Me ya sa za ta ƙi arziki da matsayi saboda shi?
gratitude: Amma budurwar ta tuna wanda ya taimake ta lokacin wahalarta.
gratitude-2: Babban suna bai warkar da ita ba.
gratitude-3: Arziki bai warkar da ita ba.
gratitude-4: Zomo ya yi nasara inda wasu suka kasa.
lesson: Ta zaɓe shi kuma ta cika alkawarin mahaifiyarta.
lesson-2: Ƙawayenta sun bar kishi ya sa su juya mata baya.
lesson-3: Wasu sun yi wa Zomo shakka kafin su ga abin da zai iya yi.
end-2: Don haka ta auri Zomo, ta zaɓi wanda ayyukansa suka fi muhimmanci a gare ta.
wood.ask: Me ya sa yarinyar ta shiga daji?
rescue.ask: Ta yaya iyalinta suka same ta?
choice.ask: Me ya sa ta zaɓi Zomo?
